# deterministic category ordering by (type-name, string-value)
def type_name(v):
    if isinstance(v, bool): return "boolean"
    if isinstance(v, (int,float)) and not isinstance(v,bool): return "number"
    if isinstance(v, str): return "text"
    return type(v).__name__
cats=sorted({(type_name(r["category"]), str(r["category"]), r["category"]) for r in valid},

                    fontproperties=title_prop,color="#111111")

# Wrap while preserving all supplied characters (line breaks only)
def wrap_cjk(s, max_chars):
    # Preserve spaces and punctuation; fixed character chunks with preference for spaces after threshold.
    lines=[]
    rest=s
    while len(rest)>max_chars:
        cut=max_chars
        # prefer a nearby space, but keep the space in content by moving it to next line then stripping no chars
        pos=rest.rfind(" ",0,max_chars+1)
        if pos>=max_chars//2:
            cut=pos+1
        lines.append(rest[:cut])
        rest=rest[cut:]
    lines.append(rest)
    return "\n".join(lines)
